strategies.name: Reduce-scatter then all-gather pattern
strategies.desc: Replace each all-reduce with a reduce-scatter followed by all-gather, performing local scaling operations on the smaller reduced chunks between the scatter and gather phases. 16 collective dispatches (8 RS + 8 AG). Reduces per-rank communication volume during the reduction phase at the cost of doubling collective count.

strategies.name: Pipelined dual-buffer staging
strategies.desc: Use two buffers to overlap computation of stage N+1's local operations with the all-reduce communication of stage N, issuing non-blocking all-reduce calls. Still 8 all-reduce dispatches but with async overlap potential. Hides local computation latency behind communication, though synchronization points may limit gains at 224 ranks.

strategies.name: Hierarchical two-level reduction
strategies.desc: Exploit multi-node topology by performing intra-node all-reduce followed by inter-node all-reduce at each stage, with local ops between levels. 16 collective dispatches (8 stages × 2 levels). Optimizes for bandwidth hierarchy when nodes have faster local interconnect than cross-node links.
